rawInput.new_text:
def save(path,text):
 open(path,"w").write(text)
 os.replace(path,temp_path)
 with open(path,"r") as f:
  old_text = f.read()
 with open(path,"w",encoding="utf-8") as f:
  f.write(old_text)
 if os.path.exists(temp_path):
  os.remove(temp_path)
